2609.11870.title: Augustinian BabyLM: What Ostensive Definition Can and Cannot Teach a Small Language Model
2609.11870.paper_summary: A language model normally begins training with random word embeddings: whatever 'banana' means must be learned from training corpora. I implement St. Augustine's picture of word learning, meaning by ostension, for a small masked language model (DeBERTa) trained on 10M words: before training, visually grounded tokens receive embeddings derived from the image regions they label; other tokens start random. Visual initialization leaves a measurable imprint that lasts until the end of training. At the same time, the effect remains invisible under most BabyLM benchmarks, which probe abstract grammatical knowledge: visual initialization does not affect performance there. The only zero-shot exception is object-property knowledge (COMPS, Misra et al. 2023), where seeding helps in every configuration. To follow up on this result, I build a corpus-tailored version of the Visual-Property Swap benchmark (Lin et al., 2026), which tests color, material, size, and shape knowledge, with per-item training frequency and seeded status. Here, vision-seeded models have a persistent, seed- replicated advantage, confined to the seeded words. As a causal test, I show that synthetic grounding of previously unseeded words transfers the advantage to exactly those words. Function words and abstract vocabulary also receive strong visual seeds and retain them throughout training, and the training objective draws on them: held-out mask-prediction loss falls for these words in every seed. However, no benchmark I run registers this. What evaluation would pick this up remains an open question.
2609.11870.paper_summary_zh: 一個語言模型通常從隨機的詞嵌入開始訓練：無論「香蕉」的意思是什麼，都必須從訓練語料中學習。 我實現了聖奧古斯丁對詞彙學習的描述，即透過指示的方式，為一個在1000萬個詞上訓練的小型掩蔽語言模型（DeBERTa）進行實踐：在訓練之前，視覺基礎的標記接收來自它們標記的圖像區域的嵌入；其他標記則隨機開始。 視覺初始化留下可測量的印記，持續到訓練結束。 同時，這種效果在大多數BabyLM基準下仍然是不可見的，這些基準探測抽象的語法知識：視覺初始化在那裡不影響性能。 唯一的零-shot例外是物體-屬性知識（COMPS，Misra等，2023），在每個配置中，種子都有幫助。 為了跟進這一結果，我建立了一個針對語料庫的視覺-屬性交換基準版本（Lin等，2026），該基準測試顏色、材料、大小和形狀知識，並考慮每個項目的訓練頻率和種子狀態。 在這裡，視覺種子模型擁有持久的、種子複製的優勢，僅限於被種子的詞彙。 作為一個因果測試，我展示了之前未被種子的詞的合成基礎將優勢轉移到正是那些詞上。 功能詞和抽象詞彙也接收強大的視覺種子並在整個訓練過程中保留它們，而訓練目標也依賴於它們：這些詞的持出掩蔽預測損失在每個種子中都下降。 然而，我運行的任何基準都沒有記錄到這一點。 什麼評估能夠捕捉到這一點仍然是一個未解的問題。
